0022600138.text: The Bucks (1-3, 5th in the Central, 12th in the East) host the Houston Rockets (4-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West), who have won four straight, while Milwaukee has won its most recent game after a 1-3 stretch over its last four. Houston is missing Steven Adams, who is out with a calf strain, and Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings with Houston in 2025-26, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026.
